decisions.decision: Do not use the installed `pageindex` PyPI package — it is a paid cloud SaaS client (api.pageindex.ai), not a local library. Build a custom python-docx + regex tree indexer instead.
decisions.rationale: Discovered by the phase researcher reading the installed package source directly. Using it would violate D2 (patient/document data never leaves the machine).

decisions.decision: 20-code human spot-check acceptance list replaces the invalid 01015C reference (verified absent from both source CSVs) with 20 CSV-verified-present codes spanning 檢查/處置/治療/手術/預防保健/藥品 categories.
decisions.rationale: 01015C does not exist in either the payment or drug CSV; constraints.md only cites it as an illustrative example, not a hard requirement.

decisions.decision: The real source corpus is 32 files (11 .doc + 21 .docx), not the 34 files (11 .doc + 23 .docx) originally estimated in CONTEXT.md/RESEARCH.md.
decisions.rationale: Verified directly via glob against the actual officialdocument/審查注意事項/ directory. Tests were written to assert against the live glob count rather than a hardcoded number, so this does not require any further fix.

The loaded model (Ornith-1.0-9B) defaults to emitting a full reasoning/thinking trace, making each call ~30s and risking empty content when max_tokens is small — this would make the ~13,942-code batch build infeasible. Disabling thinking mode (a documented llama.cpp chat-template parameter) cuts latency to ~0.6s/call.
